title: Dav's Boatracing
description: Boatcam, Boathud, Boatutils, etc. All the boatmods you'll need and all working for 1.21.11
body:
# Dav's Boatracing 
is a lightweight, performance-focused Fabric modpack built for one thing: competitive boat racing.

## Features
### Racing-Focused Gameplay
Enhanced boat experience with dedicated boat utility mods
Smooth handling for competitive racing events
Water visibility improvements for easier navigation
Custom race tracks, time trials, and multiplayer competitions

### Spectator & Content Creation Tools
Freecam support for race coverage
BoatCam for immersive racing perspectives
Camera utilities for cinematic shots
Better screenshots and zoom features
Mocap support for recordings and events

### Track Building & Event Management
WorldEdit integration for fast track construction
WorldEditCUI visual editing support
Convenient building utilities and quality-of-life improvements
Ideal for creating custom rivers, canals, circuits, and obstacle courses

### Multiplayer Ready
Built-in Simple Voice Chat support
Xaero's Minimap and World Map
Chat improvements and communication tools
Stable performance for multiplayer racing servers

### Highly Optimized
Includes numerous optimization mods such as:

Sodium
Lithium
ModernFix
Entity Culling
More Culling
ImmediatelyFast
Dynamic FPS
BadOptimizations
GPU Booster

These improvements help deliver high frame rates, lower memory usage, and smoother gameplay during races and large events.

### Included Categories
Racing Utilities
Camera & Spectator Tools
Building Tools
Performance Optimizations
Multiplayer Enhancements
Visual Improvements
User Interface Improvements
Mapping & Navigation

### Perfect For
Competitive boat racing servers
Community racing tournaments
Speedrunning custom courses
Content creators and event organizers
Friends looking for a unique multiplayer experience
Players who want a lightweight, optimized Fabric setup
### Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.1
Fabric Loader
Recommended: 4GB+ RAM for multiplayer events
